title: Repairing a Garbage Disposer: Jam Clearing and Manual Rotation Techniques

locations.name: Under-sink disposer area (probable, kitchen)
locations.basis: Transcript references to components located under the sink and at the bottom of the sink; explicit filming location not stated

summary: This Old House shows how to diagnose and clear a jam in a kitchen garbage disposer. The video identifies the main parts (flange, locking ring, splash guard, and cutter wheel), explains how jams cause the motor to hum and trip an overload switch, and demonstrates sequential techniques to free a blockage using an Allen wrench, manual rotation, and improvised high-torque tools before testing the unit to verify operation.
topics: jam causes (foreign objects or excessive food)
Allen wrench access to disposer shaft
professional torque tool for access (pro wrench)
disposer testing after clearing a jam

sections.title: Disposer mounting components and access points
sections.description: Identify the main mounting parts (flange, locking ring, splash guard) and how the disposer attaches under the sink.

sections.title: Jam scenarios and overload protection
sections.description: Explain how a jam makes the motor hum and may trip an overload/reset switch, and introduce the overload protection mechanism.

sections.title: Allen-wrench access and initial clearance attempts
concepts: Allen wrench access to the shaft
manual rotation of the cutter wheel
sections.description: Demonstrate using the built-in Allen wrench to rotate the cutter wheel and clear small jams or visible obstructions.

sections.title: Escalating torque with improvised tools
sections.description: If initial clearance fails, show applying higher torque with improvised tools and a pro wrench for better access.

sections.title: Applying torque to free the jam
concepts: torque application on the cutter wheel
sections.description: Continue applying torque on the cutter wheel to dislodge the jam, turning counterclockwise as needed.

sections.title: Test run and confirmation of operation
sections.description: With the jam cleared, perform a test run to verify the disposer operates smoothly and correctly.

featured_techniques.technique: Manual rotation of the cutter wheel using the built-in Allen wrench
Inspecting and clearing a jam by turning the wheel to dislodge foreign objects
Using improvised high-torque with broomsticks to turn the disposer shaft
Employing a pro wrench to access the deck and apply torque safely
Resetting the overload switch after a jam and performing a test run
